_refresh_query._doc: Run these on the master VPS (sqlite3 /opt/velox/current/.velox/data/velox.db) to regenerate this file when the DB is repopulated. Then manually copy source files to storage_key paths if the cached blobs are missing (see _restore_blobs).
_refresh_query.voiceover: SELECT a.asset_id, a.mime_type, s.source_reference FROM assets a JOIN asset_sources s ON a.asset_id = s.asset_id WHERE a.kind = 'voiceover' AND a.status = 'READY' AND s.source_type = 'file' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 2
_refresh_query.clips: SELECT a.asset_id, a.mime_type FROM assets a WHERE a.kind = 'stock_clip' AND a.status = 'READY' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 3
_refresh_query.counts: SELECT kind, COUNT(*) FROM assets WHERE status = 'READY' GROUP BY kind ORDER BY count DESC
_refresh_query.storage_keys: SELECT asset_id, storage_key FROM assets WHERE asset_id IN (<ids>)

_restore_blobs._doc: If jobs fail with 'voiceover asset not found', the cached blobs at storage_key paths are missing. Copy source files back:
_restore_blobs.command: for id in ccc7f50e... b5bc023f...; do KEY=$(sqlite3 velox.db "SELECT storage_key FROM assets WHERE asset_id='$id'"); [ ! -f "$KEY" ] && cp /opt/velox/current/.velox/data/e2e-smoke/voiceover.mp3 "$KEY"; done
